request_text: Create a repeatable top-view technical I/O plate of a Raspberry Pi 5. Find authoritative references first, show and label the requested connectors, preserve the real board layout, and do not invent hidden or unsupported components.
subject: Raspberry Pi 5

forbidden_features: generated text inside the base image

visual_output.surface_treatment: clean engineered surfaces, consistent line weight, no sketchiness, no decorative texture
visual_output.label_strategy: generate no text or callouts in the raster; deterministic labels and leader lines are added after candidate validation
